Being vane-sworn to a star does not carr.why: "Vane-sworn" is a made-up relation (catalogued as vane_sworn_to, fictional, no property tags): it does not occur in Dolma or on Wikipedia, and has no default reading about whether a tie to a star carries up to its galaxy. A made-up relation has no property to contradict.

notes: RBox expansion paired with physics-replace-0017 (which makes 'orbits' not carry over to the galaxy of the star): a made-up relation, vane_sworn_to, is given the same property (its chain with located_in does not hold), applied to real planets and stars. The first instance leaves the real hop (the Sun lies in the Milky Way) out of the prompt, so the model must use what it holds; the second states both facts and asks whether it could fail (yes). Caveat: a negative property on a made-up relation leaves little to overturn, since nothing is known about vane-sworn before the edit, so the 'does not follow' answers may hold without the edit. The negation is the plain opposite of the edit (carries over); its answer is no. The near unrelated query asks the real chain for orbits, whose answer stays yes. Side facts and the far unrelated query are the revision's.
